name: Witch Doctor: Spirit Volley swaps only the highest known Reclamation rank, through a bar redraw
contract: Spirit Volley Ready (505158) makes AscensionWitchDoctor::SyncReplacements retarget the Reclamation action-bar slot to Spirit Volley (504582); casting Spirit Volley consumes the buff and the slot reverts to Reclamation. Reclamation ranks are registered in spell_ranks (806288 chain) and are mana spells, so every learned rank stays active in the spellbook. Only the highest known rank is retargeted, and lower ranks are never touched. The swap reaches the client as a resent action bar, not as SMSG_SUPERCEDED_SPELL (which the client answers with a learned-spell chat line, #5762): neither gaining the buff nor casting Spirit Volley sends a superseded-spell packet.

steps.label: Let login hooks and class synchronisation settle
SETUP: the highest learned Reclamation rank is known
Spirit Volley Ready retargets the highest Reclamation rank
Let the throttled sync run again
No superseded-spell packet, however many Reclamation ranks are known
The client's Reclamation button carries Spirit Volley
Lower Reclamation ranks are left untouched
The lower rank's button is left untouched
The cast consumes Spirit Volley Ready
The action bar reverts to the highest Reclamation rank
Let the throttled sync run again
Casting Spirit Volley sends no superseded-spell packet either
The client's button carries Reclamation again
